title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified ILSP stories — judo history, hoops signings and a rough week for Maccabi Haifa.

questions.question: At Rio 2016, whom did Or Sasson defeat in the round of 32 on his way to a judo bronze medal — the bout that made headlines when his opponent refused to shake his hand?
questions.explanation: Sasson beat Egypt's Islam El Shehaby in the round of 32; El Shehaby then refused to shake his hand and was later reprimanded by the IOC.

questions.question: Which club has NBA veteran Shake Milton agreed to join on a one-year, $1 million contract?
questions.explanation: Milton agreed personal terms with Hapoel Jerusalem after being cut loose by Partizan Belgrade, which had activated an opt-out clause.

questions.question: On his first appearance on loan for Ironi Kiryat Shmona, in which minute did Niv Gabai score against his parent club Maccabi Haifa?
questions.explanation: Gabai scored in the 7th minute as Kiryat Shmona beat Maccabi Haifa 3-0 in the Toto Cup.

questions.question: What status change freed up an international roster slot for Ilay Feingold at New England Revolution?
answers: He was granted a US green card
He signed a new US work visa
He became a naturalized US citizen
He was loaned to a US developmental side
questions.explanation: As a permanent resident holding a green card, Feingold no longer occupies an international slot under MLS rules.

questions.question: Maccabi Haifa's 3-0 Toto Cup loss to Kiryat Shmona was their second such defeat in a week — who else beat them 3-0, in the Haifa derby?
questions.explanation: Maccabi Haifa lost the Haifa derby to Hapoel Haifa 3-0 before suffering the identical scoreline against Kiryat Shmona in the Toto Cup.
